paragraphs: R' Tahlifa. R' Tahlifa said in R' Shila bar Avimi's name; see his entry. R' Tahlifa said, “I saw Rav Huna”; see his entry. When Ravin came, Rav Tahlifa said to him: Sanhedrin 20, end of side a. R' Tahlifa: R' Nasa said, “Many times I ate with R' Tahlifa Abba”; see his entry. R' Tahlifa asked Rav Hisda, “Did our teacher not teach us thus?”: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Ba-Meh Madlikin.
